title: Stage-by-stage replay — Query Failure Diagnostician
description:
The query failure diagnostician answers 'why did my search fail?' with evidence instead of shrugs. It replays the failed query through instrumented stages — parsing, planning, index access, ranking — and classifies the failure: syntax error, empty index partition, timeout, permission denial, upstream outage. Each diagnosis ships with the fix or the escalation path, turning support tickets into self-service.

This record documents the stage-by-stage replay approach: Re-run the query with tracing at each pipeline stage to find where results were lost.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Query Failure Diagnostician demo: stage replay classifies the failure.
def diagnose(query,filters,index_stats):
    stages=[]
    if not query.strip(): return "syntax: empty query"
    stages.append("parse:ok")
    for f in filters:
        hit=index_stats["facet_counts"].get(f,0)
        stages.append((f,hit))
        if hit==0: return "empty-result: filter '%s' matched 0 records (killed the query)"%f
    if index_stats["slow_shard"]: return "timeout: shard %s stalled (p99 %dms)"%index_stats["slow_shard"]
    return "no failure detected: "+str(stages)
print(diagnose("sails",["topic=sails","year>2030"],{"facet_counts":{"topic=sails":120,"year>2030":0},"slow_shard":None}))
print(diagnose("sails",["topic=sails"],{"facet_counts":{"topic=sails":120},"slow_shard":("s3",9000)}))
provenance: Public-harvest: documents established, real-world methods for query failure diagnostician; fact-checked public knowledge.
